name: Donatello
author: zaboyca

sections.description:
Donatello is a feature-rich donation plugin that allows you to collect donations on your WordPress site using WooCommerce. It provides a customizable donation page, statistics tracking, and a user-friendly interface for donors.

Key features:
– Automatic creation of a donation page at yoursite.com/donatello, where all payments are processed
– A hidden WooCommerce product for processing donations (do not modify or delete this product)
– Customizable donation amounts and prompts
– Donation statistics with goal tracking
– Optional fireworks animation for donor engagement
– Secure payment processing via WooCommerce

Short Description

A powerful donation plugin for WordPress, integrated with WooCommerce for secure and customizable fundraising.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the donatello folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings under Settings > Donatello.
  4. A donation page will be automatically created at yoursite.com/donatello.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the donation page?

Yes, you can customize the page title, text, donation amounts, and more via the plugin settings.

Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes, Donatello requires WooCommerce to process payments securely.
